name: week
title: Service quality this week
subtitle: Fictional records in the demo. Internal planning, human review required.

sections.title: Reviews to complete
sections.sql: select source_id,name,agent,channel,review_due,days_overdue from v_review_queue order by review_due

sections.title: Coaching commitments
sections.sql: select source_id,name,agent,owner,due_on,days_overdue from v_coaching_due order by due_on

sections.title: Score spread
sections.sql: select * from v_calibration order by spread desc
sections.note: Calibration never contributes to production performance.

sections.title: Production performance
sections.sql: select team,agent,count(*) reviews,round(avg(score),2) average_score from v_scores where kind='production' and status='final' and not under_appeal and not withdrawn group by team,agent
sections.note: Draft, disputed and withdrawn assessments are excluded.

sections.title: Record checks
sections.sql: select * from v_compliance order by rule,record
sections.note: Checks support human review. They do not certify compliance.

sections.title: Appeals
sections.sql: select a.source_id,s.agent,s.conversation,a.reason,a.due_on,a.status from appeals a join v_scores s on s.id=a.review_id order by a.due_on
